        sumset.add(s)

# 3. Count the number of unique sums
size_S = len(sumset)

print(f"Sequence t: {t}")
print(f"Size of the sumset |S|: {size_S}")

def generate_t(k):
    N = 87 # Indices 0 to 86
    t = [0] * N
    
    # t_i = 2i for i <= k
    for i in range(k + 1):
        t[i] = 2 * i
    
    # t_i = 2i - 1 for i > k
    for i in range(k + 1, N):
        t[i] = 2 * i - 1
    
    return t

def calculate_sumset_size(t):
    sumset = set()
    n = len(t)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i, n):
            sumset.add(t[i] + t[j])
    return len(sumset)
